The 2027 Domani 311BH Is the Nicest Bunkhouse Travel Trailer Around
19 photos
Photo: YouTube/Pine Acres RV Moncton
Instead of a New Year's resolution, KZ RV kicked off the new year with a new product line, as befits any respectable RV manufacturer. The Domani line of travel trailers, described as yacht-like on the inside but more spaceship-like on the exterior, currently counts with six floorplans, including the one that's been described as the nicest bunkhouse travel trailer around.
Domani debuted in early 2026, with the first demo units for the largest and smallest floorplans arriving as 2026 model years. Right now, KZ RV is already shipping 2027 units out to dealers, which makes this as good a time as ever to discuss about the Domani gem that hardly gets any attention, though it should.
That would be the Domani 311BH, or Domani DM311BH by its full name, the bunkhouse floorplan from the series. Being a bunkhouse model makes this the most family-friendly unit as well, but don't take that to mean less style, less attention to detail, or any kind of compromise for quality.
The 311BH has sleeping for as many as eight people at once, but the high sleeping capacity doesn't come at the expense of style or comfort . Like the other Domani floorplans, this one too features interiors inspired by yacht design, with an exterior that brings to mind spaceship comparisons.
Photo: KZ RV A Domani is designed to stand out from afar, as you must know if you're familiar with these new trailers. It's painted a lighter gray with automotive paint and an automotive windshield on that distinctive front cap, and it features a lighting system that allows you to turn it into a real attention magnet at camp.
More than a looker, a Domani is designed for superior comfort, with very nice amenities. Since the debut of the Domani range in January 2026, comparisons with the Brinkley travel trailers have abounded, and not few are those who tip the scales in Domani's favor, especially if they also consider the lower price tag.
The 311BGH comes with aluminum framing and laminated Azdel composite panels, Tufflex PVC roofing, and a chassis with tandem axles and a dropped frame construction at the front. Total length is at 36 feet 10 inches (11.2 meters), and while the chassis isn't a widebody one, you still get more volume to work with at camp thanks to the single, quite large slide-out.
Photo: YouTube/Pine Acres RV Moncton It holds a pair of electric theater seats with recliner, massage, and heat functions, a residential 12V fridge, and a pantry with adjustable shelves and pull-out cubbies. Across the way, so directly to the left hand side of the main entry (this unit has two entryways, one of which gives into the main bedroom for maximum privacy and convenience), is the entertainment center.
The TV is on a televator, which allows KZ to have the living space flow organically into the kitchen, but also to offer you uninterrupted views of the campsite if you want them. A large electric fireplace and some storage is also included.
Also here is a pull-out sofa that can accommodate two more extra guests, once you extend it fully into the living room space. It comes with overhead cabinetry for storage and a large mirror that does the trick of making this space feel larger than it is.
Photo: YouTube/Pine Acres RV Moncton The mid kitchen is compact but excellently appointed, with solid surface seamless counters, soft close hinges on all opening doors, dovetail joinery on the drawers, and premium appliances. That means a three-burner gas cooktop with a large oven, a GE microwave, an extractor, and the 12V fridge some distance away. An all-accessory sink, heaps of storage space, and plenty of workspace for meal prepping are also included.
At the rear is the "BH" part of the name, the bunkhouse. Unlike with other travel trailers , it seems that KZ is striving to create a real room for the kids, a space that wouldn't feel like an afterthought or a halfway solution to them. In the 311BH, that means double-over-double bunks, each with their own windows and lights, but also a privacy door, a wardrobe, and some space for shoes before stepping into the beds.
At the other end of the trailer is the parents' bedroom, which is imagined as a private oasis with plenty of space and even more privacy. It comes standard with a king bed with heaps of storage, including in drawers under the bed, a closet with washer-dryer prep, prep for a second TV, and the aforementioned second entry.
Photo: YouTube/Pine Acres RV Moncton A second low-profile AC unit is also available here.
The only bathroom onboard is right outside the main bedroom. It might prove not enough if the trailer is at maximum capacity because people will be queuing up to use it, but once inside, it will work. Standard equipment here includes a nice walk-in one-piece fiberglass shower, a porcelain toilet, and a stainless steel sink on a vanity with integrated storage .
Designed for family use and entertaining, the DM311BH comes with an outdoor kitchen under the larger awning, with a slide-out electric griddle and a compact fridge just perfect for drinks.
Photo: YouTube/Pine Acres RV Moncton Standard features include smart power control, including for the KZ-patented four-zone lighting system, prep for solar, an on-demand tankless water heater, a 30,000-BTU furnace, two AC units, large storage compartments outside, electric auto leveling, and two LP tanks. This trailer will hold 45 gallons (170 liters) of freshwater, 76 gallons (287 liters) of gray, and 30 gallons (113 liters) more of black water.
KZ RV lists a gross weight for the 2027 Domani DM311BH of 9,800 lbs (4,445 kg) with 1,500 lbs (680 kg) of cargo, and an MSRP of $80,461. That said, the final sale price will depend on options and the dealer you're getting it from.
Photo: YouTube/Pine Acres RV Moncton Speaking of dealers, the video tour below is courtesy of a Canadian, over-enthusiastic dealer that's already made up their mind that this Domani is better than a Brinkley any time of day. But you decide that for yourself.
